item.title: 10 new albums to stream this week
item.description: The new albums from Hen Ogledd, Liz Cooper, and The Messthetics & James Brandon Lewis should be at the top of your queue today. Tap in and find a new obsession.

item.title: I Can Only Imagine 2 doubles its amount of annoying Christian rockers
item.description: The second film based around a single Christian rock hit, I Can Only Imagine 2 is more inarticulate than outright bad.

item.title: Mario Puzo wasn't sure audiences would understand the title Apocalypse Now
item.description: In a newly discovered letter between Francis Ford Coppola and Mario Puzo, Puzo offers Coppola some title advice. In fairness, Coppola also didn't know the meaning of "apocalypse."

item.title: William Shatner to bring staccato talk-singing growl to heavy metal album
item.description: The 94-year-old Transformed Man, William Shatner, is working on a 35-song "heavy-metal extravaganza" for Trekies and metalheads to enjoy.

item.title: Final Destination Bloodlines team are sinking its teeth into a Venom animated movie
item.description: IN development from the Final Destation Bloodlines team, the next Venom movie may have Tom Hardy, in cartoon form, that is.
